name: BrowserStack
description_en:
BrowserStack is a product in the Software testing category. Its directory profile covers Geo Location Testing, Live Web Testing, Bug Tracking, Continuous Integration, Seamless Integration, Test Recorder, Cross Device Testing, Reporting and Analysis.

Additional listed capabilities include Parallel Testing, Scheduling, Cross Browser Support, Debugging, Access Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $25.00. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: record software defects and follow their progress; allocate times for appointments, resources or tasks; work with supported browsers in a common workflow; inspect program execution to investigate faults; restrict information and actions according to permissions. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
BrowserStack 属于软件测试软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括地理位置测试、在线网站测试、缺陷跟踪、持续集成、集成能力、测试录制工具、跨设备测试、报表与分析。

资料还列出并行测试、排程管理、跨浏览器支持、代码调试、访问控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $25.00. 另有持续免费方案和定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：记录软件缺陷并跟踪处理进展；为预约、资源或任务安排时间；在同一流程中使用受支持的不同浏览器；检查程序执行过程以定位故障；根据权限限制信息访问和操作。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。

research_gaps.en: Official home, documentation index and the Local Testing architecture page were read. The pricing root timed out twice; a discovered official product/annual pricing URL exceeded the web reader size limit, and a normal public HTTP read also timed out. No usable actual pricing body or free-use grant was established; snippets are discovery only, and no price is adopted.
research_gaps.zh: 已读官方首页、文档索引及 Local Testing 架构页。总定价入口两次超时，发现的官方产品／年付价格地址超出网页工具大小限制，普通公共 HTTP 读取也超时。未建立可用真实价格正文或免费授权，搜索摘要仅供发现，不采用金额。

research_gaps.en: Local Testing routes remote cloud browsers to allowed private servers through an outbound encrypted agent/repeater tunnel. Ending a browser session and shutting down the tunnel are separate operations. This documentation was read; no binary, access key, session or network route was operated. Exact SDK setup, concurrency, retention, fee and license coverage remain incomplete.
research_gaps.zh: Local Testing 经出站加密 Agent／转发器隧道，让远端云浏览器访问获准私有服务。结束浏览器会话与关闭隧道是不同操作。本次仅读文档，未操作程序、访问密钥、会话或网络路由；具体 SDK 设置、并发、保留、费用及许可覆盖仍不完整。
